_comment: Preview for Task 3.10 (certified minimal-mass map, constant-density Fuchs shell). 2x2 cells around the canonical geometry: R2=20 m, Delta/R2 in {0.5, 0.25}, v in {0.02, 0.005}. Decision gate after preview: (a) canonical M_min <= 2.7e27 nominal, (b) thresholds bisect cleanly (minec_below < 0 < minec_above), (c) per-cell runtime acceptable -> run mmin_map_full locally; escalate to HF Jobs only if the full grid ETA is unreasonable.
